title: Fair Multi-View Determinantal Coresets via Adaptive NEPv
abstract: arXiv:2608.18181v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting a small, diverse subset from a large candidate pool often means balancing several incompatible notions of diversity. In trademark curation, for instance, a subset should cover both the language used to describe marks and the visual space of their logos. A single determinantal point process (\DPP) kernel can hide failure in one view, and averaging kernels replaces the multi-view relaxation by an ordinary single-kernel spectral problem. We formulate \emph{fair multi-view determinant selection}: maximize the weakest per-view log determinant of a size-$k$ subset. We smooth this nonsmooth objective and relax it to the Stiefel manifold. The relaxation embeds every discrete subset exactly, but unlike its single-view counterpart it has no closed-form spectral solution in general. translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18181v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从大型候选池中选择小而多样化的子集通常需要平衡几种不兼容的多样性概念。例如，在商标策展中，子集应同时覆盖描述商标的语言和其标识的视觉空间。单个行列式点过程（\DPP）核可能在一个视角中隐藏失败，而平均核则通过普通单核谱问题替代多视角松弛。我们提出\emph{公平多视角行列式选择}：最大化大小为$k$的子集的最弱每视角对数行列式。我们平滑此非光滑目标并将其松弛到Stiefel流形上。该松弛精确嵌入每个离散子集，但与其单视角对应不同，它通常没有闭式谱解。其平稳性条件是一个规范不变的非线性特征值问题，具有依赖于特征向量、视角自适应的权重。我们推导出一种自适应自...
tldr: 本文提出了一种公平多视角行列式选择方法，通过平滑目标函数并松弛到Stiefel流形，解决了多视角多样性平衡问题，并推导出自适应非线性特征值求解算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fair multi-view determinant selection method that smooths the objective and relaxes it to the Stiefel manifold, addressing multi-view diversity balance, and derives an adaptive nonlinear eigenvalue solver.
